keyLimits.en: 625 credits/month, 5 parallel generations, 3 projects, no watermarks, 4K upscaling, 20GB storage.
2,250 credits/month, 15 parallel generations, 5 projects, 1 Brand Kit, 1 voice clone, credit top-ups available, 100GB storage.
9,500 credits/month with 1-month rollover, 20 parallel generations, 10 projects, 3 Brand Kits, 3 voice clones, studio-grade HDR/ProRes output, 500GB storage.

cautions.en: Free plan credits are a one-time grant, not a recurring monthly allowance, so the free tier runs out quickly.
cautions.fr: Les crédits du plan gratuit sont accordés une seule fois, pas chaque mois, donc le plan gratuit est vite épuisé.

capabilities.en: AI video, image and audio generation and editing in one cloud workspace.
Multiple in-house generative models (Gen-4.5, Gen-4 Turbo, Gen-4 Images) with 4K upscaling.
Developer/API platform (Runway Dev) with a model router for programmatic access.
Robotics and world-simulation tools (Runway Robotics, General World Model) for policy training.

limitations.en: Free plan credits are a one-time allowance rather than a recurring monthly quota.
Watermark-free output and 4K upscaling require at least the Standard paid plan.
Brand Kits and voice cloning are limited by tier (1 on Pro, 3 on Max) and unavailable below Pro.

reason.en: Direct competitor in AI video generation from text and image prompts.
Direct competitor offering comparable AI video generation models.

unknowns: Whether Enterprise-level custom plans exist above Max was not confirmed on the pricing page as fetched.
